workflow.en: Specify the visual palette, movement rules, feather interactions, sound and touch controls in one detailed brief.
workflow.zh: 把配色、运动规则、羽毛交互、音效与触屏操作写成一份完整需求。

title.zh: 会自己玩耍的三维亲子空间

summary.en: A warm playroom with toys, climbing structures and a child character, built as an interactive Three.js scene.
summary.zh: 用 Three.js 构建温暖的亲子空间，包含玩具、攀爬设施和会在玩具之间活动的儿童角色。

workflow.en: Define the room, toy and action models separately, choose a stylized aesthetic, and request zoom, orbit and a local Vite workflow.
workflow.zh: 分别定义空间、玩具与动作模型，采用风格化美术，加入缩放、旋转和 Vite 本地开发流程。

limitations.en: Scope follows the author’s published post.

limitations.en: Scope follows the author’s published post.

workflow.en: The author supplied the topic, requested Remotion, and describes Astra assembling the visuals, narration and edit.
workflow.zh: 作者给出主题并指定 Remotion，随后由 Astra 组织视觉素材、旁白和剪辑。

limitations.en: Scope follows the author’s published post.

title.zh: Grok Bot 交互式 3D 键盘

summary.en: A reference image becomes a polished 4K product visualization with manufactured detail, PBR materials, studio lighting and interactive controls.
summary.zh: 把一张参考图变成精细的 4K 产品可视化，包含工业级几何细节、PBR 材质、棚拍灯光与完整交互。

workflow.en: Start with a short identity prompt and a reference image, then ask Astra to upgrade the prototype while preserving keys, dials, camera controls, finishes, lighting and exploded view.
workflow.zh: 先用一句角色化需求和参考图搭出原型，再让 Astra 在保留按键、旋钮、镜头、材质、灯光和爆炸视图交互的前提下整体升级。

limitations.en: The polished result builds on an existing prototype and the visual reference shown in the author’s thread.
limitations.zh: 精修结果建立在已有原型和作者帖子中的视觉参考图之上。

prompt.text: Upgrade the existing isolated prototypes/grokbot interactive 3D keyboard to a 4K, markedly more realistic, premium product visualization with detailed manufactured geometry, convincing PBR materials, and refined studio lighting; preserve and validate key, dial, orbit, zoom, finish, lighting, and exploded-view interactions; pass the project's tests and production build.

alt.zh: Grok Bot 高质感交互式 3D 键盘

title.zh: 交互式 V8 发动机可视化

summary.en: A detailed cutaway V8 engine pairs moving mechanical parts with gauges, charts and controls in an explorable technical visualization.
summary.zh: 以剖面 V8 发动机为核心，把运动机械结构、仪表、图表和控制面板组合成可探索的技术可视化。

workflow.en: Give Astra a concise subject and quality target, leaving it room to design both the mechanical scene and the explanatory interface.
workflow.zh: 用一句话明确主题与质量目标，让 Astra 同时设计机械场景和讲解界面。

limitations.en: The public prompt is intentionally broad; the author does not specify the rendering stack or an engineering-accuracy target.
limitations.zh: 公开提示词刻意保持宽泛，作者未说明渲染技术栈，也未把工程精度作为验证目标。

prompt.text: Create a highly detailed, interactive visualization of a V8 engine.

alt.en: Interactive cutaway visualization of a V8 engine
alt.zh: 交互式 V8 发动机剖面可视化

summary.en: A mobile welcome screen combines an astral backdrop, playful sticker-like elements and a tactile liquid-glass panel.
summary.zh: 移动端欢迎页将星空背景、贴纸式趣味元素和可触碰的液态玻璃面板融合在一起。

workflow.en: Set a clear screen goal, name the available design tools and cite a specific interaction reference for the glass effect.
workflow.zh: 明确页面目标与可用设计工具，并为玻璃效果给出具体的交互参考。

limitations.en: The result uses Appllama MCP and app-design skills already available in the author’s environment.
limitations.zh: 该成果使用了作者环境中已有的 Appllama MCP 与应用设计技能。

prompt.text: /goal Using Appllama MCP + App design skills build a welcome screen that has an astral theme, liquid glass displacement inspired by Wabi.

alt.en: Astral mobile welcome screen with liquid glass interaction
alt.zh: 带液态玻璃交互的星空主题移动端欢迎页

title.zh: 从 Zillow 房源到电影感 3D 漫游

summary.en: Listing photos are reconstructed as a Blender scene and turned into a fluid, roughly one-minute promotional walkthrough.
summary.zh: 根据房源照片重建 Blender 场景，并生成约一分钟、镜头连续流畅的宣传漫游视频。

workflow.en: Provide a listing URL, request headless Blender reconstruction, define a one-take cinematic camera style, and require visual checks and iteration to production quality.
workflow.zh: 提供房源链接，要求用无头 Blender 重建，再明确一镜到底的电影化运镜，并要求视觉检查和迭代打磨。

limitations.en: The author notes some geometry errors in the one-shot result and used existing Rome workflows to fetch listing images and add audio.
limitations.zh: 作者说明一次生成的结果仍有几何细节错误，并使用了已有的 Rome 工作流抓取房源图片和添加音频。

prompt.text: Use blender headless to recreate 3D model of this house: https://zillow.com/homedetails/349-Walsh-Rd-Atherton-CA-94027/15598337_zpid/ and then create a beautiful stunning walkthrough promotion video for the listing. You are an expert cinematographer and animator working in Blender. When creating videos from 3D models, prioritize cinematic quality and visual richness over speed. Be meticulous and thorough. Infer the spatial relationship if needed. The video's camera movement should be bold and fluid, with a cinematic, blockbuster feel. I'd like one-take feel, continuous, unbroken movement. Do visual checks to make sure the 3D model and video look professional quality. Iterate until it is production ready. Target a video length 60 seconds-ish.

alt.en: Cinematic Blender walkthrough reconstructed from a Zillow listing
alt.zh: 根据 Zillow 房源重建的电影感 Blender 漫游
